## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; market shows mixed sector leadership with Energy/Healthcare/Staples outperforming while most sectors are soft, and leadership concentration Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Confirmations: narrow sector positivity (only 3/11) and split performance between large-cap Tech strength and widespread 1W weakness in several cyclicals/industrials.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +3.91%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.43% | 1M: +4.84%), COP ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.30% | 1M: +1.44%). Healthcare supportive: UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +24.48%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.95% | 1M: +11.16%). Consumer Staples strength anchored by PM ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.89% | 1M: +21.36%) and WMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.78% | 1M: +5.51%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Utilities lag: CEG BELOW TREND (1W: -12.00% | 1M: -10.68%) and broader utility weakness. Consumer Discretionary weak: BKNG BELOW TREND (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -16.49%) and AMZN in CORRECTION (1W: -3.13% | 1M: +5.78%). Communication under pressure: CHTR BELOW TREND (1W: -9.38% | 1M: -40.53%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: CSCO ABOVE TREND (1W: +22.41% | 1M: +39.89%), PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +16.81% | 1M: +45.43%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.43% | 1M: +4.84%), PM ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.89% | 1M: +21.36%), F ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.14% | 1M: +9.07%). Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); style: mixed/no clear leadership.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: AMD CORRECTION (1W: -6.83% | 1M: +52.41%), EL CORRECTION (1W: -6.87% | 1M: +6.56%), BKNG BELOW TREND (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -16.49%), BA CORRECTION (1W: -7.11% | 1M: +0.74%), QCOM CORRECTION (1W: -8.03% | 1M: +49.84%). Weakness concentrated in short-term pullbacks among high-1M performers.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W moves: CSCO (1W: +22.41%), PANW (1W: +16.81%), OXY (1W: +12.43%); watch RECOVERY/CORRECTION divergences across megacaps—major divergence present (AMD, QCOM, INTC showing CORRECTION vs strong 1M), so treat momentum as tactical not universal.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed/internal rotation: NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.70% | 1M: +13.60%), AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.45% | 1M: +14.09%), MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +0.39%) but notable CORRECTIONs at AMD (1W: -6.83% | 1M: +52.41%) and INTC (1W: -12.93% | 1M: +58.79%); sector breadth negative in the 1W snap despite strong 1M leadership.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Mixed-to-weak: V ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.40% | 1M: +3.59%) while JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -3.92%) and MA BELOW TREND (1W: -0.26% | 1M: -4.69%); sector under pressure in 1W and not a clear lead for risk-on.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Supportive and among the few positive sectors: UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +24.48%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.95% | 1M: +11.16%), JNJ RECOVERY (1W: +2.44% | 1M: -3.34%); Healthcare breadth is positive within the 3/11 cohort.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Energy and selective Healthcare/Staples exposure (XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +3.91%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +24.48%), PM ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.89% | 1M: +21.36%)) and reduce exposure to lagging Consumer Discretionary and Utilities; style: mixed with tactical bias to cyclicals where momentum exists.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: CSCO ABOVE TREND (1W: +22.41% | 1M: +39.89%), PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +16.81% | 1M: +45.43%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +24.48%) — watch for follow-through. BEARISH: BKNG BELOW TREND (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -16.49%), CHTR BELOW TREND (1W: -9.38% | 1M: -40.53%), INTC CORRECTION (1W: -12.93% | 1M: +58.79%) — watch for trend breaks.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +6.59%; part of 3/11 positive), Healthcare (1W: +0.65%; among the three positive sectors). BEARISH: Utilities (1W: -2.73%), Consumer Discretionary (1W: -2.53%) — breadth negative outside the three leaders.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA resistance ~900 to signal continued ABOVE TREND extension (NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.70% | 1M: +13.60%)). AAPL support ~175 to hold the ABOVE TREND base (AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.45% | 1M: +14.09%)). XOM breakout above ~120 would confirm Energy follow-through (XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +3.91%)). JPM support ~150 to watch for any reversal back to ABOVE TREND (JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -3.92%)).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
CEG (+80): Constellation revenue jump and raised outlook; price BELOW TREND (1W: -12.00% | 1M: -10.68%) — sentiment diverging from price, watch for distribution. PFE (+75): Hemophilia approval headline; price BELOW TREND (1W: -1.36% | 1M: -5.41%) — bullish catalyst but not yet price-confirmed. LLY (+60): Guidance upgrade and trial news; LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.95% | 1M: +11.16%) — sentiment confirming price.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
BKNG (-55): Cut guidance/new debt headline and BKNG BELOW TREND (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -16.49%) — sentiment confirming weakness. AMZN (-45): AI governance backlash; AMZN in CORRECTION (1W: -3.13% | 1M: +5.78%) — watch for follow-through from sentiment.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership and Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +3.91%), CSCO ABOVE TREND (1W: +22.41% | 1M: +39.89%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +24.48%) are showing relative strength. Key risk: major 1W/1M divergences (AMD, QCOM, INTC in CORRECTION) and several bullish-news names (CEG, PFE) where price is not confirming—monitor for trend breaks.
